messages.subject: Plot without x-axis ticks/labels
parts:
Hi, 

I'm trying to plot a few QTL scans on top of each other for a manuscript and only want the x-axis chromosome labels on the bottom plot. Using xaxt = 'n' doesn't hide the ticks and tick labels though. Is there any way to hide the ticks and labels on the x-axis with plot.scanone?

Thanks, 
Ellen

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Plot without x-axis ticks/labels
parts:
Unfortunately, there's limited control over that sort of thing.
So you're best bet is to make a copy of the function and edit it.

Here's the code that puts the x-axis:

    https://github.com/kbroman/qtl/blob/main/R/plot.scanone.R#L281-L299

You can download the file from github, or you can use dput() from within R:

    dput(qtl:::plot.scanone, "myplotscanone.R")

karl
